text:
olivia: Quick check — final prep for the launch drip next week. Who's owning creative for Wave B and can we lock send windows? Need final subject + preview by EOD Friday :timer_clock:

jamal: I can own creative for Wave B. leaning toward 2 subject variants: 'Meet Redwood Inference — faster LLM inference' and 'Ship LLM features with predictable latency'

kevin: prefer the second. also push variant with emoji? 'Ship LLM features ⚡ with predictable latency'

maria: added subject suggestions + preview text in the doc: https://tiny.redwood/launch-waveb (sheet). Also uploaded the Wave B hero image into /assets/launch/B.png

olivia: thanks. segmentation — we agreed warm trial users + engaged newsletter opens last 30d for canary, right?

jamal: yes. canary = 5k users, send window Tue 10am PT. full send Thu 9am PT optimized by timezone. code snippet for segment cmd:
```
segment_filter = "trial_status:active AND opens_30d:true"
send_list = export(segment_filter)
```

marketing-bot: Reminder: A/B test IDs must be registered in MarTech by 2026-03-20 18:00Z. Use test_id prefix: launch_waveb_ab

kevin: tracking — utm_campaign=waveb_launch, utm_content=subjectA|subjectB. confirm reply-to is support@redwood.ai

maria: confirm GDPR suppression run scheduled, will attach suppression list to send job. also need legal signoff on one sentence about data residency for VPC customers.

olivia: canary creative: create two headlines + one CTA variant. jamal — mockups by EOD Thursday?

jamal: yep attaching mocks in doc, updated the subject matrix. also propose dynamic token for {{model_name}} for customers on private plan.

kevin: dynamic tokens ok but test fallback for null value: 'your model' fallback. add that to QA checklist.

maria: QA checklist updated: deliverability, fallback tokens, link tracking, unsubscribe header, reply-to, sf sync, suppression. pinging @ops to run a dry-run Monday.

marketing-bot: Deploy ticket created: #MK-1324. Canary send scheduled 2026-03-24T17:00:00Z.

olivia: perfect. final ask — two-line internal launch blurb for CS and AMs, whoever can draft?

kevin: i'll draft and share in 30 mins.

olivia: awesome. :rocket:
